summary: City Council unanimously approved a 120-day moratorium on new data centers to review zoning, utility and environmental impacts before developing regulations.
notes: Second Oregon city identified using a 120-day land use moratorium, the same term adopted by Hillsboro in July 2026 under Oregon's local moratorium statute. Establishes the instrument as a pattern in Oregon rather than a single instance.
